correctness.rationale: For M>=4, Casabella--Sammartano prove the three orthogonality quadrics form a prime regular sequence of codimension three. Differentiation gives a nonzero hollow symmetric H with VH=0 exactly when singular. det(H)=2abc partitions the nonzero patterns into one-edge (B_k) and two-edge (A_k) cases, with the all-edge case forcing V=0. A_k is the cone over Segre(P^1 x Q^(M-2)), dimension M and degree 2(M-1). Three linear B_k imply degree 6M-3 of the reduced union. Explicit local eliminations leave nondegenerate transverse Hessians of rank 2M-2 at general B_k and A_k. Exact symbolic checker returns EXACT_CHECK_OK for M=4,5,6,7; its finite range is not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural three-column zero fiber is the smallest genuine multi-edge off-diagonal Gram variety. The complete reduced singular support, degree 6M-3, and common generic node type throughout the six distinct components are intrinsic structural geometric data not supplied by published FRS/factorial thresholds. This is a motivated infinite-family classification and normal-slice result, not a normalization exercise, unmotivated special slice, or marginal parameter gain.
